title: The PCP-for-PPAD conjecture: a quasilinear reduction

abstractEnglish: We prove the quasilinear-size PCP-for-PPAD conjecture of Babichenko, Papadimitriou, and Rubinstein. There are fixed positive rational constants ε and δ and a deterministic polynomial-time reduction that transforms an End-of-Line instance of binary length N into a generalized circuit of total binary length $`N(\log N)^{O(1)}`$. From any rational assignment of polynomial encoding length that ε-satisfies all but a δ fraction of the gates, a solution to the original End-of-Line instance can be recovered in polynomial time, regardless of which gates fail. Such assignments always exist, with one fixed polynomial bound on their encoding length.
titleEn: The PCP-for-PPAD conjecture: a quasilinear reduction

details.overview: 该稿件研究 Babichenko、Papadimitriou 与 Rubinstein 提出的 PCP-for-PPAD 猜想。作者声称证明了拟线性规模的版本：存在固定正有理常数 ε 与 δ，以及确定性多项式时间归约，把长度为 N 的 End-of-Line 实例变为总长 N(log N)^{O(1)} 的广义电路；只要有理赋值满足除 δ 比例外的所有门，就能在多项式时间内恢复原实例的解，且不论哪些门失败。摘要表示此类赋值总存在，并有统一的多项式编码长度界。
keyPoints: 归约把 End-of-Line 实例变为总长 N(log N)^{O(1)} 的广义电路。
从 ε-满足几乎所有门的有理赋值可多项式时间恢复原实例解。
摘要称此类赋值总存在，且编码长度有统一多项式界。
